title: ProAgent: Building Proactive Cooperative Agents with Large Language Models

layout.note: A small unframed workflow ring on the left and a large rounded frame on the right, joined by two dashed grey lines from the ring's dashed ProAgent box to the frame corners; the key of four arrows sits under the ring, a wide memory bar closes the frame at the bottom.

lesson: Pair a small ring that shows who acts with a dashed wedge into a large framed panel that replays one real turn with actual prompt and output strings, keeping module names and colours identical in both and explaining arrow colours with a four-arrow key.
